title: Wolverine: Paradise #1
desc:
ESCAPE...INTO DANGER!

LOGAN steps from the X-MEN...but awaiting under the glitz and glamour of MIAMI is a simmering criminal underworld, and a crucible that will bring out the warrior, the mutant—the Wolverine!

Writer-Artist DAN PANOSIAN takes the reins of Wolverine, steering him into an all-new, can't miss, auteur-driven adventure, where "paradise" ain't exactly what you'd expect.

Guest-starring DAZZLER, the heat is on, and will only cook hotter from here on out, so don't miss the launch of this all-new series!
